acceptance: GitHubCache exposes a read-only verification report that scans every existing cache entry deterministically, validates namespace and entry safety, metadata source identity, manifest and entry digests, and never creates, repairs, deletes or fetches anything.

aipo package cache verify <dir> reports a stable package diagnostic for an unsafe root or corrupt entry, succeeds with a zero-entry report for a missing or empty cache, and leaves the filesystem unchanged.
Verification rejects symlinks, non-regular files, malformed metadata, source/key mismatches, malformed manifests and digest mismatches while continuing to inspect independent entries.
The operation is available in the default network-free build, performs no authentication or registry access, and source commands plus fetch/lock operations retain their existing cache policies.

Positive and negative tests cover valid, missing, empty, corrupt, symlinked and unexpected cache contents, CLI argument validation and read-only behavior; documentation and full repository gates remain green.

amendments.reason: Lock the read-only cache verification scope before implementation

evidence.description: aipo-package default tests passed 48 cases and all-features tests passed 51 cases, including valid/missing/corrupt/unexpected cache verification, regular-file and symlink safety, source/key checks and digest verification.

aipo-cli package integration tests passed 26 cases by default and 27 with github-http, covering read-only cache verification, missing-root no-create behavior, corruption diagnostics, argument validation and existing package behavior.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features passed; the default build remains free of ureq and no live GitHub test was used.

cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo doc default/all-features, node selftest, cargo deny, cargo audit, prumo validate and prumo doctor all passed.
CLI reference, ADP-007, GitHub fetch security documentation, CHANGELOG and PROJECT_STATE now define the read-only cache verification policy and its no-network/no-mutation boundary.
prumo tool scan-secrets crates, docs and .ai reported no secrets; git diff --check passed.
